hints.title: Periodicity Invariant
hints.text: Every contiguous subarray of length k has equal xor sum if and only if nums[i] == nums[i + k] for all i.

hints.title: Grouped Frequency Counts
hints.text: Partition nums into k groups based on index modulo k. Count frequencies of existing numbers within each group.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming over Bitwise Prefix Sums
hints.text: Compute dp[i][val]: minimum changes across the first i groups to have cumulative bitwise prefix sum val. Either choose an existing element or rewrite the group to any arbitrary value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through k groups over bitwise domain [0, 1024), maintaining rolling 1D cost arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 1024^K combination assignments is computationally impossible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Group frequency grouping combined with default arbitrary replacement minimizes search space to 1024 states per group.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Periodicity deduction followed by bitwise DP with min-value fallback optimization.
